create_PixtralProcessor: create a PixtralProcessor instance with hf_config, server_args, and a HuggingFace processor for Pixtral image tokenization
process_mm_data_async: process a list of image data items asynchronously with spatial merge and multi-image splitting into MultimodalProcessorOutput
build_MultimodalSpecialTokens: build MultimodalSpecialTokens with image_token and image_token_id for Pixtral tokenizer special tokens
split_multi_image_mm_items: split a single IMAGE multimodal data item into per-image items based on effective patch size and nrows
calculate_image_nrows: calculate the number of image rows for each image using HF _num_image_tokens with effective patch dimensions
